BiblicalUsage: Slime is bitumen, the sticky pitch of the ancient world, and it holds the bricks of Babel together, fills the pits where the kings of Sodom fall, and daubs the ark of bulrushes that carries Moses. The same slime builds a tower and saves a baby.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the slime shows that God uses the same stuff for judgement and for rescue: the pits swallow kings and the pitch keeps the ark afloat.
RelatedEvents: The Tower of Babel; Abram Rescues Lot; Moses' Birth and Flight to Midian
